description: A PHP template/view file responsible for rendering the default project index page in a web application. It includes PHP logic for displaying project details, supporting modular view components, and setting up meta tags for social sharing.

classes.name: View
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering views and templates, with methods for including subviews and replacing parts of the layout.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents users within the application, providing methods to retrieve user data such as personal info.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Manages image data and provides methods for retrieving image links with specific dimensions.

classes.name: Blog
classes.description: Represents blog data associated with projects or site-wide blogs, containing posts and gallery information.

methods.name: View::get
methods.description: Fetches and renders a specified view component with given parameters.

methods.name: User::getPersonal
methods.description: Retrieves personal information of a specified user by user ID.

methods.name: Image->getLink
methods.description: Provides a URL to the image with requested dimensions and options.

methods.name: Text::text
methods.description: Retrieves localized or predefined text strings from the translation library.
